headline.deduplication_note: Distinct Primary Tumor sample entities are counted once each in both numerator and denominator, even when a sample has multiple open WXS MAF files or compound EGFR variant occurrences.
headline.label: observed selected EGFR calls among file-linked primary-tumor samples

provenance.upstream_source: NCI Genomic Data Commons (GDC) Public REST API

scope_and_denominator.denominator_definition: All distinct GDC TCGA-LUAD Primary Tumor samples in Data Release 46.0 linked via HAS_ALIQUOT + HAS_FILE to at least one released open-access WXS Masked Somatic Mutation (MAF) file. Denominator establishes WXS Masked Somatic Mutation MAF availability, not wild-type locus coverage.
known_coverage_gaps: Molecular variant ingest is explicitly scoped to open-access GDC /ssm_occurrences in gene EGFR (GRCh38, canonical transcript ENST00000275493); other genes (e.g. KRAS, ALK) are not ingested in this snapshot.

GDC open-access WXS Masked Somatic Mutation MAFs and /ssm_occurrences report called positive masked somatic variants only; explicit wild-type (NEGATIVE) calls and locus-level sequencing depth at unmutated sites are not provided.
Controlled-access BAM/VCF/MAF files, pathology_reports, and cross-cohort GDC-to-PDC identity mappings are omitted.

molecular_coverage.limitation: GDC /ssm_occurrences and open-access WXS Masked Somatic Mutation MAF files record positive called masked somatic variants only. Locus-level callable reference depth is absent; samples without a listed variant cannot be inferred to be wild-type / negative.
